name: Foreground Process Guard
summary: Block recognizable indefinite development processes launched in the foreground.
description: Classifies bounded static shell commands and stops common servers, watchers, and follow-mode tools unless a timeout, detached session, or explicit background boundary is present.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks recognizable indefinite development processes launched in the foreground; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not kill existing processes or manage process supervisors.
It does not block bounded one-shot build and test commands.
It does not execute dynamic shell content to discover its duration.

entrypoints.purpose: Block recognizable indefinite development processes launched in the foreground.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block recognizable indefinite development processes launched in the foreground without deferred work.
